# Legal Rules and Benchmark Gate Checklist: Occupation Search, Permit Eligibility and Salary API

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements in the two areas where a wrong requirement does the
most harm: the eligibility rules (users make visa decisions on them) and the search-quality gate
(it blocks the merge).
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned. `[x]` means the reviewer judged the requirement well written,
not that it is implemented. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not change it.
Audience: the author, as a self-review before `/speckit-tasks`. Depth: standard.

## Legal rules — Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is every rule the registry must hold listed with its effective period, including the
  end dates of the 80 % maintenance requirement and of the transition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the spec say which date picks the exempt-code list and the ban list for an
  extension, and what happens when a code was exempt when the current permit was granted but is no
  longer listed? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the conditions of each personal exemption (first permit only, two-year limit for
  temporary protection, company age and size) stated as requirements rather than only in
  Assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified whether a declared personal exemption applies to an extension, given
  that the former-student exemption is defined for first work permits only? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the rounding rule for threshold amounts stated in the spec, or only in research?
  [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for a code that exists in SSYK but has no profile, and for
  a code that is valid but has no SCB salary data, in the eligibility answer? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec say which sources and checked-on dates an eligibility answer must cite
  for each rule (Migrationsverket page, SFS paragraph), so "every source" is testable?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Legal rules — Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is the transition window's end stated unambiguously as inclusive (filed on
  1 December 2026 keeps 80 %; 2 December gets 90 %)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Story 1 scenario 6]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "the latest median published on the filing date" defined for a filing on the
  day a new median takes effect (16 June 2026 uses 38 300)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Story 1 scenarios 1–2]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the stale-median trigger date consistent: the spec says after 16 June, while the
  latest date a median has taken effect is 22 June? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "permit granted before 1 June 2026" defined by the decision date of the current
  permit, and is the input field named the same way across spec, data model and contract?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Data model §EligibilityRequest]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the "not permitted" answer for banned codes specified precisely enough: which
  fields are empty (threshold, margin) and which are still shown? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Story 1 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the 9210 partial-ban wording specified so that it neither blocks other 9210 jobs
  nor implies berry picking is allowed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Legal rules — Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 - Do Story 1, FR-003, the edge cases and the data model's rule-selection order agree
  on the order of checks (ban, out of scope, transition, exemption, 90 %)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK015 - Does Story 7's timeline list (rule changes and medians) match FR-002's registry
  contents exactly? [Consistency, Spec §Story 7, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are the "out of scope" boundaries (decisions before 1 June 2026, other permit types)
  stated the same way in Edge Cases, Assumptions and the answer statuses? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is SC-002 (no threshold literal outside the registry) consistent with the
  acceptance scenarios and quickstart, which quote amounts? (Tests of the registry are allowed.)
  [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]

## Legal rules — Acceptance Criteria and Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 - Is there an acceptance scenario for every rule in the registry, including an
  extension of a permit granted after 1 June 2026? [Coverage, Spec §Story 1]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-001's "checked by hand against the sources" tied to a list of cases and a
  place where the evidence is recorded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the failure-path requirements stated for invalid combinations (extension without
  a current-permit date, decision before filing, a first permit with a current-permit date)?
  [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the yearly June update stated as a requirement with an owner and a trigger, not
  only as a stale warning? [Gap, Constitution Governance, Spec §FR-005]

## Benchmark gate — Completeness and Clarity

- [ ] CHK022 - Does FR-020 name the query subset each gate is measured on (all paired queries,
  hand-written only, or all queries per language)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is "fused at least as good as each single method" specified per language and per
  subset, given that on hand-written Swedish fusion is currently below both dense models?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the minimum number of paired queries that makes the gap gate meaningful stated
  in the spec, not only in research (n ≥ 60)? [Gap, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the leak rule (what counts as a query appearing in the indexed text, including
  inflections) stated as a requirement for both languages? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is "justified by the diagnosis" in FR-019 defined well enough to judge whether a
  query-set change is allowed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the rule that tuning uses the generated set and confirmation uses the hand-written
  set (to avoid overfitting 32 pairs) a requirement, or only a research decision?
  [Gap, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the hand-written overlap measure (at least three shared codes in the top five)
  defined in FR-020 as well as SC-004, and in which mode? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §SC-004]

## Benchmark gate — Consistency and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK029 - Do FR-020, SC-004, Story 3 scenario 3 and the clarification agree on which gates
  apply to fast mode (recall only) and which to full mode (all)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK030 - Does the spec say what happens if the gates cannot be met after the listed fixes:
  stop and ask, change the target through the constitution, or keep working? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the dependency on the pending native-speaker review stated with what it means
  for the gate (measured as is; re-run after review)? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is it specified that the benchmark and live search share the same ranking code,
  including the title-list handling and fusion weights? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-013a]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is the low-confidence cut-off's derivation (which score, what target share of
  benchmark queries, which nonsense queries) specified so that it can be reproduced?
  [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Research §R8]

## Notes

- Items come from reading spec.md, research.md and data-model.md on 2026-10-21. Several point at
  decisions that so far live only in research (CHK005, CHK024, CHK025, CHK027); the fix is usually to
  lift one sentence into the spec.
